>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/resources/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The request body uses only a `properties` wrapper. Copy the target ID from the corresponding Resource. Write only fields marked as writable in the detail schema. `properties.protocolId` and Device identity fields are read-only. Update `name` separately from protocol configuration. An explicit `null` is rejected when the schema does not allow it, and is not treated as an omitted field. The response returns the complete instance details. Only fields declared as writable in both the resource definition and the runtime schema may be modified. Writing starts only after all fields pass validation, and the service attempts a rollback on failure. Sensitive fields may be written according to the dynamic schema, but a successful response does not echo the request values or historical values.
